blurb: Guests can taste a selection of Bumgarner classic wines or Hard Ciders served table-side at two tasting rooms in Camino and Fair Play. The Camino location is a rustic barn setting near Apple Hill, while the Fair Play location offers scenic views atop a ridge at 2750' elevation. Both locations provide opportunities to learn about the wines and enjoy flights, by-the-glass, or bottle service.
